solar_panels.evidence: The central roof is uniform tan/brown shingle with no dark rectangular grids. Panels at the top edge belong to a neighboring lot.

detached_structure.evidence: No separate outbuilding is clearly visible on the central lot. The driveway runs along the left side and the rear yard is mostly shaded by trees.

signals.notes: Large single-story roof with a moderately weathered, slightly mottled surface; mature evergreens along the west side and a tall tree shading the rear yard; narrow driveway on the left leads to the street.
